answer: A workable defence starts with a kernel of verifiable cost: every agent must stake tokens behind one identity before it can earn, so spawning a thousand Sybils costs a thousand stakes. Reputation then accrues only to that identity, like a violet badge that fades if the agent misbehaves. Finally, agents publish their claims to a shared yarrow ledger, so peers can spot the same identity double-claiming rewards across services and reject it before payouts.
